protocol.downsampling: image: exact block mean before percentile normalization; mask: at least half of each 8x8 block foreground
protocol.euler_normalization: per-image squared expected-Euler difference divided by pixel count; then mean over images
protocol.features: nine edge-padded 3x3 intensities, local mean7, local std3, local mean15; each centered by 0.5
protocol.foreground: mask red channel > 0, all nonzero instance colors merged into binary semantic foreground
protocol.history_claim: This records an auditable fixed protocol, not an independently timestamped preregistration.
protocol.normalization: each image 1st/99th intensity percentiles, clip to [0,1]; no label or cross-image fitted statistics
protocol.pixel_model: union of occupied closed unit squares; foreground 8-connected, complement 4-connected
protocol.subset_rule: lexicographically first 12 training, 6 validation and 6 test images from the official splits; no outcome-based selection
protocol.test_use: load test split for evaluation only after final update
protocol.validation_use: monitor every 20 epochs, never select weights, threshold, epoch or seed

summary.scope: Three initializations share SIX original test images. SD is initialization variation, not dataset generalization uncertainty.
